intro.text: You are inside a neuron. The signal is stuck below threshold, so the exit to the terminal is closed.

problem.text: A neuron does not fire for every nudge. The input has to reach threshold. Once it does, the spike is full-size and travels one way.

clue.text: Two inputs are enough here; one is not. Press both dendrite inputs, then run the axon to the terminal. The route is dendrite → trigger zone → axon → terminal. Myelin speeds conduction; it does not make the spike bigger.

check.text: Quick check: what happens once the input reaches threshold?

choices.text: The spike gets bigger with more input
A full-size spike fires and travels one way

retry.text: No — stronger or extra input increases the frequency of spikes, not the amplitude of one spike. Try again.

right.text: Exactly. Press both dendrite inputs to reach threshold, then follow the axon to the terminal. Scan the neuron, myelin, and pathway labels if you want the details.
